concepts.name: Simulated-user evaluation
concepts.definition: Evaluation in which a separate user model reveals requirements and responds to the target agent, making user policy, information partition and role accounting part of the measured system.

evidence.claim: Multi-step evaluation keeps the agent environment across steps while resume_trajectory separately controls agent-session continuation. Uploaded per-step workdir content overlays existing state rather than establishing a full environment reset.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.

evidence.claim: The advanced example verifier mutates config.txt to test non-hardcoded behavior. Shared verifier cleanup removes specific test/output directories, not a general rollback of all grader effects.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.

evidence.claim: FINAL selects the last executed step result, while mean includes only steps with verifier_result and fills missing reward keys with zero among that included set. Completion and denominator reporting therefore require separate fields.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.
This helper does not determine final job-level validity or leaderboard error handling.

evidence.claim: In the advanced example, implement min_reward=0.5 does not itself provide partial credit: the inspected verifier/helper writes binary rewards 0/1.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.

evidence.claim: The simulated-user path runs user_agent as the outer agent using persona, bridge instructions and task instruction. The target is driven through the bridge. MultiStepTrial rejects user_agent; these are distinct orchestration modes.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.
Prompt privacy and a read-only role instruction are not by themselves operating-system isolation.

evidence.claim: The ACP bridge stores extracted target usage in context.metadata.acp_target_usage. The extraction walks the session export and retains the last token-usage mapping, rather than summing all mappings or proving it is session-cumulative.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.
Selected mapping may or may not be cumulative for a given CLI export; no live export was observed.
The metadata path alone is not evidence that target and user costs are combined.

evidence.claim: The inspected tomlkit task combines adaptive persona-guided disclosure with final base/new test execution. Task-specific budgets, image tag, role instructions and final verifier are part of its evaluation condition.
limitations: Source-level flow only; no Harbor trial, cloud environment, model or ACP CLI executed.
The complete hidden test patch and real persona rollout were not audited or executed.
